This is a personal archive of Liz Lisa items. This site is not affliated with Liz Lisa in any way. To purchase Liz Lisa items, please visit the official sites at [tokyokawaiilife.jp](https://www.tokyokawaiilife.jp/) and [tokyokawaiilife.com](https://tokyokawaiilife.com/).

Note: For the purposes of tracking the correct year that an item is released in, the winter season is considered as January 1–March 20 and December 21–December 31 for each year.
